sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This policy prohibits the AI uses barred by the Texas Responsible Artificial Intelligence Governance Act (HB 149) for {org_name} within {boundary}. Aligned to the statute; not legal advice. The broadly-applicable prohibitions in Section 2 apply regardless of actor type; the provisions in Section 3 bind governmental entities.

sections.heading: 2. Prohibited Uses (all actors)

questions.prompt: Who owns enforcement of the prohibited-use policy and reviews AI uses against it?

sections.body: {org_name} does not develop or deploy AI with the intent to: unlawfully incite or encourage self-harm, harm to others, or criminal activity; intentionally unlawfully discriminate against a protected class; or produce unlawful sexually explicit synthetic media, unlawful deepfakes, or prohibited child-related content. These prohibitions are enforced at the decision boundary where technically feasible and reviewed by {prohibited_use_owner}.

sections.heading: 3. Additional Governmental Prohibitions
sections.body: Where {org_name} is a governmental entity, it additionally does not use AI for prohibited social scoring, or for biometric identification or capture without the consent required by law.
